access_links.label: OpenDataPhilly dataset page (CSV, SHP, GeoJSON, API)

description: The Philadelphia bike network is a line dataset from the City of Philadelphia, published on OpenDataPhilly, that holds the network of streets with bike lanes and streets considered bicycle-friendly. The dataset page offers a web map of bike lanes and downloads as CSV, shapefile and GeoJSON, plus an API, each updated as needed. Coverage: the City of Philadelphia. Format and access: open downloads and an API without registration. Licence and cost: free under the City's open data terms of use; the terms say the City keeps all rights in the database, gives no warranty of accuracy and that use of the data is at the user's own risk. Caveats: the page gives no field list or update date, and bicycle-friendly streets without lanes are mixed with marked lanes, so attributes must be checked before routing. It gives the network layer for network flow and capacity planning studies of cycling. It relates to the PeopleForBikes network analysis and BikeDNA in the catalogue, which can assess it.
